This is one of the Editions. Every pedal ships as different Editions, each built around a genre or scene, made together with musicians from it.
Each Edition holds several Programs: individual sounds, each made with one specific artist.
A Program is either a Synthesizer (creates its own sound) or an Effect (transforms whatever comes in).
Every Program has its own simulated pedal: real knobs and switches.
Touching a knob or switch, like this one, opens its info box down here. Watch the numbers change as it moves.
Two switches are special. This one flips every control to a second, hidden set of sounds.
The other special switch changes how the buttons behave: hold one down to sustain the sound, or press once to latch it on.
Press play to hear what this Program actually sounds like.
See who made it, and their other collaborations, under Artist.
